run_linear_approx_saliency: run linear approximation saliency visualization on a PyTorch model's intermediate layer activations
run_gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency: run gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency on a tensor with valid gradients to compute a saliency map
create_saliency_map: create a saliency map by multiplying activations with their gradients and summing across channels
test_linear_approx: test the linear_approx function by passing a model, input tensor, and target class index
review_gradient_to_linear_approx_salienc: review the gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency function to understand how it computes element-wise activation times gradient
